broker.help.stop: Waits until the price crosses your stop, then trades at market. Classic stop-loss.

lab.locked.need: Unlocks at {rank} ({amount} net worth). Train models that read the market, run trading bots and defend your empire.
lab.intro: Capability = Algorithm × Compute^0.34 × Data^0.28. Research raises the algorithm, GPUs and cloud budget buy compute, data comes from brokers, scraping, synthesis and your own businesses.
lab.gpu.title: GPUs
lab.gpu.sub: Owned hardware: free compute every day, but it draws power (your own power plants cover it). Resells at 60%.
lab.reserve.title: Reserved compute
lab.reserve.sub: Prepay a block of cloud compute per day: $2.00 per PFLOP-day at the reference Compute price. Counts toward every run while it lasts.
lab.data.title: Data
lab.data.sub: Data decays 2% a day (freshness). Your businesses deliver partnership data daily; software, media and compute businesses deliver the most.
lab.researchers.title: Researchers
lab.researchers.sub: $1,500 a day each. Each one speeds research 5% and cuts training failure odds by a point.
lab.train.title: New training run
lab.train.name: Model name
lab.train.careful: Careful run (50% longer, fails a third as often)
lab.train.starved: Data-starved: buy data or the run underperforms (the best runs balance compute and data).
lab.models.none: No models yet. Research, then train.
lab.bot.title: Deploy a trading bot
lab.bot.sub: Bots trade with your money through the same order book as everyone. Better models see the market more clearly and act more often. Crowded strategies stop working.
lab.strategy.momentum: Momentum: buy what is rising today
lab.strategy.value: Value: buy below fair value (needs trees)
lab.strategy.trend: Trend: follow the moving average (needs RL)
lab.signals.title: Analyst signals
lab.signals.sub: Your analyst model scans the market for the biggest gaps between price and fair value. One pack per game day, delivered to your inbox.
lab.bots.title: Your bots

boutique.intro: Lifestyle turns money into Prestige: status, access and a target on your back.
boutique.prestigeNote: Prestige counts the best item in each category fully, the second half, the third a third: breadth beats forty identical cars. Mass items fade; limited and unique pieces gain heritage and track the collectibles index ({index}×).
boutique.experience: An experience: the memory fades after 30 days.
biz.intro: Businesses earn every tick, even while you sleep. They compete for each city’s customers: upgrades win share, crowding loses it. Your property (homes and rentals) lives here too.
biz.none.title: No businesses yet.
biz.none.body: A street food cart costs $1,500 and pays for itself in about a real day. Upgrades and higher tiers pay more.
prop.movedIn: Moved in. Homes earn Prestige instead of rent.
legal.intro: Cases need evidence: 40 points clears the civil bar, model theft needs 55. Counsel shifts the odds slightly, never decisively. Verdicts award damages to you and a fine (a share of the loser’s net worth) that mostly leaves the economy. Nothing takes anyone below $5,000.
legal.file.title: File a case
legal.file.evidence: Evidence against {name}: {points} points. Filing fee $2,000 + counsel.
legal.filed: Case filed. Hearing in 2 game days.
legal.cases.title: Your cases
security.locked.need: Unlocks at {rank} ({amount}). Watch your connections, run scans, and, if you dare, run operations against rivals. Crime has an expected value; courts collect.
security.conn.title: Connections
security.conn.sub: Everything talking to your systems: data feeds, broker links, partners. Hostile sessions hide among them.
security.defense.title: Defense
security.defense.hint: Spending adds defense with diminishing returns: 40·√(budget/10k). $10k/day also unlocks T1 auto-scans.
security.lockdown.hint: Lockdown cuts every connection, pauses your AIs for 2 days and costs $500 per legit reconnect; then 12 days of shield.
security.anomalies.title: Anomalies
security.anomalies.sub: Some are clues, most are noise. The same endpoint named again and again is the tell.
security.ops.intro: Plant a hidden session on a rival’s systems. While it stays connected it slowly copies their best model (never more than 85%). It can be found, and found sessions become evidence in court. New players, rookies and shielded accounts are off limits; hitting someone far smaller costs five times more.
security.evidence.title: Evidence you hold
security.evidence.sub: Points from sessions you cut and attempts you blocked. File in court above 20 points; 40 clears the civil bar.
security.recent.title: Recent operations
security.strength.whisper.label: Whisper
security.strength.whisper.text: Easier to plant, slow to copy, hard to spot.
security.strength.tap.label: Tap
security.strength.siphon.label: Siphon
security.strength.siphon.text: Hard to plant, copies fast, leaves loud clues.

coach.tradeDone.title: First trade done
coach.tradeDone.body: Trading is half the game. Businesses earn all the time, even while you sleep: a street food cart pays for itself in about a real day, and keeps paying.
coach.protect.title: Protect the downside
coach.protect.body: {ticker} is down {pct} since you bought. A stop-loss sells it for you if it falls to a price you choose.
coach.business.title: You’re in business
coach.business.body: Check your three daily contracts in Settings for quick rewards, and watch your rival in the top bar. Reach {amount} to become a {rank}.
learn.term.broker.name: Broker
learn.term.broker.def: The window that charts one ticker and places orders. You can open up to four, one per ticker.
learn.term.ticket.name: Ticket
learn.term.ticket.def: The order form inside a Broker: side, order type, quantity and price. Only Enter in the Broker sends an order.
learn.term.ticker.name: Ticker
learn.term.ticker.def: The short code for a tradable asset, such as HLCN. Each ticker has its own chart, news and price.
learn.term.market_order.name: Market order
learn.term.market_order.def: Buys or sells now, at the best price available.
learn.term.limit_order.name: Limit order
learn.term.limit_order.def: Buys or sells only at your price or better. It waits until the market gets there.
learn.term.stop_order.name: Stop order
learn.term.stop_order.def: Waits until the price reaches your stop price, then sells or buys at market. Often used to cap a loss.
learn.term.stop_limit.name: Stop-limit order
learn.term.stop_limit.def: A stop order that then places a limit order at your limit price, so it fills at that price or better, or not at all.
learn.term.trailing_stop.name: Trailing stop
learn.term.trailing_stop.def: A stop that follows the price by a set percentage. It sells if the price falls that far from its best level since you placed it.
learn.term.position.name: Position
learn.term.position.def: The shares you hold in one asset, with your average cost.
learn.term.cash.name: Cash
learn.term.cash.def: Money you can spend now. Buying takes cash, and selling adds it back.
learn.term.net_worth.name: Net worth
learn.term.net_worth.def: Cash plus everything you hold, at today’s prices. It is the figure in the status strip.
learn.term.unrealized_gain.name: Unrealized gain
learn.term.unrealized_gain.def: Profit or loss on shares you still hold. It moves with the price until you sell.
learn.term.fee.name: Fee
learn.term.fee.def: A charge taken from cash on each trade. Fees differ by asset class.
learn.term.slippage.name: Slippage
learn.term.slippage.def: The gap between the price you expected and the price you got. Large orders in thin markets move the price against you.
learn.term.margin.name: Margin
learn.term.margin.def: Borrowed money that lets you buy more than your cash covers. You pay interest. A margin call comes below 30% equity, and the broker sells for you below 20%.
learn.term.short.name: Short
learn.term.short.def: Selling shares you do not own, by borrowing them, so you profit if the price falls. You buy them back later.
learn.term.option.name: Option
learn.term.option.def: A contract to buy (a call) or sell (a put) an asset at a fixed strike before expiry. The most you can lose is the premium you paid.
learn.term.strike.name: Strike
learn.term.strike.def: The fixed price in an option. A call pays when the price ends above it; a put pays when it ends below.
learn.term.expiry.name: Expiry
learn.term.expiry.def: The day an option ends. It settles in cash at that day’s close.
learn.term.wire.name: Wire
learn.term.wire.def: The news feed: headlines, world events, milestones and rival moves, newest first.
learn.term.rumor.name: Rumor
learn.term.rumor.def: An unconfirmed story. Rumors are right most of the time, but not always.
learn.term.priced_in.name: Priced in
learn.term.priced_in.def: How much of a news move has already happened. Early means most of it is still to come; Priced in means it is done.
learn.term.earnings.name: Earnings
learn.term.earnings.def: A company’s quarterly report of profit and sales. How it beats or misses expectations moves the price.
learn.term.analyst.name: Analyst
learn.term.analyst.def: A paid helper that explains your closed trades: the market, the sector, the news and the fees.
learn.term.world_event.name: World event
learn.term.world_event.def: A market-wide event, such as a storm or a major shock. The biggest ones take over the screen for a moment.
learn.term.sector.name: Sector
learn.term.sector.def: A group of companies in the same business, such as tech or energy. Sectors often move together.
learn.term.volatility.name: Volatility
learn.term.volatility.def: How far prices swing, up and down. High volatility means bigger moves in both directions.
learn.term.day.name: Game day
learn.term.day.def: One day in the game. A day order expires at the end of that day, and the status strip shows the day and the time.
learn.term.rank.name: Rank
learn.term.rank.def: Your standing in the game, from Broke up to Dynasty. Each rank unlocks apps and workspaces.
learn.term.prestige.name: Prestige
learn.term.prestige.def: Status points from lifestyle purchases and homes. You see them in Boutique.
learn.term.business.name: Business
learn.term.business.def: Something you own that earns income every game day. Away for more than 12 hours, it slows down unless you automate it.
learn.term.contract.name: Contract
learn.term.contract.def: A goal with a reward. You get three each game day; claim the reward once it is done.
learn.term.license.name: License
learn.term.license.def: A permission that unlocks a kind of trade, such as options with the Derivatives license. Settings shows your licenses.
learn.term.company.name: Company
learn.term.company.def: Your own company, from Owner rank. Company building arrives in a later release.
learn.term.research_desk.name: Research Desk
learn.term.research_desk.def: A private room that explains why a stock moved over closed days. It opens at Operator rank.
learn.term.workspace.name: Workspace
learn.term.workspace.def: A separate desktop with its own windows. You get more as your rank rises.
learn.term.focus_mode.name: Focus mode
learn.term.focus_mode.def: Hides the wallpaper and shelf and turns windows into plain tiles for fast trading. Shortcut: Ctrl .
learn.term.layout.name: Layout
learn.term.layout.def: A saved arrangement of windows. Trade, Review and Research come built in; you can save up to five of your own.
learn.term.shelf.name: Shelf
learn.term.shelf.def: The bar at the bottom of the desktop with your apps. Locked apps stay greyed out until their rank.
learn.term.launcher.name: Launcher
learn.term.launcher.def: Ctrl K opens a search for apps, tickers and commands.
